name: GAN 12 UI SP 3x3 (Magnetic, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The GAN 12 UI SP 3x3 (Magnetic, UV Coated) – Bluetooth Smart Cube is a premium smart speed cube that combines GAN’s fast turning feel with accurate motion tracking for training and analysis. Piece magnets provide crisp layer “clicks,” while a magnetic angle sensor system uses 6 core angle sensors to capture motion precisely and help prevent “lost steps” during fast solves.
features: Smarter training: High-sensitivity motion capture records your solves more reliably, even at higher TPS.
Fast, controlled turning: Magnetic pieces improve alignment for cleaner execution and fewer lockups.
Durable high-grip finish: UV coating adds glossy grip that stays consistent over time.
Easy, repeatable tuning: Defined settings make it simple to dial in your preferred feel.
GES Pro+ dual adjustment: 6 tension settings + 6 compression settings for quick, repeatable setup.
GMS V3 magnet system: 4 magnet strength settings to match your turning style—lighter for speed or stronger for control.
